prompt: Nu contacta de două ori același proprietar din două anunțuri.
environment: Local Firestore emulator, real CRM action executor and AI dispatch transaction, simulated Vapi provider. No external calls or real-model run in this batch.
verifiedBehaviors: Recording a contact outcome saves the normalized contacted phone, using the ready canonical source when the agency favorite lacks a phone.
An outcome recorded on another listing blocks AI dispatch to that phone, including inactive prospects.
Editing the current phone does not change the phone associated with a newly recorded outcome.
Incomplete dates, different phones and explicit unknown contacted phones are not treated as evidence of contact at the target number.
Outcome clearing resets the phone snapshot; unrelated note edits preserve it.
Prior concurrency, provider uncertainty, agency isolation and membership checks still pass.
limitations: Not a full 0262 certification: manual calls outside the app and message-purpose-aware deduplication remain uncovered.
Legacy outcomes without phone snapshots rely on the current prospect phone; historical identity cannot be reconstructed when it has changed.
Cleared outcomes and unrecorded contacts are not recovered by this current-state check.
Large agency history performance remains unverified; dispatch reads agency calls and prospects transactionally.
